simple.meaning: שָׁחַט (shâchaṭ) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to hammer out.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 5 times in 1 Kings, 2 Chronicles, beginning at 1 Kings 10:16. The surrounding contexts include kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׁחַט (H7820) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: שָׁחַט (shâchaṭ) / H7820 is traced through 1 Kings 10:16, 1 Kings 10:17, 2 Chronicles 9:15, 2 Chronicles 9:16 with source-language evidence and verse context.
